summary: Supplier credit note posted to wrong cost center causing GL variance during March close
description:
Issue summary:
A supplier (Aurelio Systems) submitted a credit note on 2026-03-02 for invoice INV-2026-117. The credit note was processed by AP on 2026-03-03 but was posted to cost center 700-DEV instead of 720-OPS. This caused a negative adjustment to the DEV OPEX for March and a corresponding GL variance in the monthly close reconciliation.

Impact:
- Finance month-end close for March shows a -$24,312 variance in cost center 700-DEV.
- Internal P&L for Product shows incorrect OPEX allocations affecting headcount budgeting.
- Potential downstream impact on chargebacks to product teams if not corrected before close.

Environment:
- ERP: AcmeLedger v4.9 (production)
- AP workflow: AP-Portal v2.1 -> Batch posting service (ap-posting-svc)
- Region: us-east accounting cluster

Steps to reproduce / verify:
1) Search ERP for supplier Aurelio Systems, document CN-2026-03-02 (credit note).
2) Inspect GL posting for that document: journal JRN-2026-533 shows cost center 700-DEV.
3) Compare vendor ledger vs invoice INV-2026-117 and original PO PO-4412; original PO cost center is 720-OPS.
4) Review ap-posting-svc logs for 2026-03-03 02:10-03:00 UTC window.

Logs / evidence attached in ticket (references below).
investigation_notes: 03-10: Initial triage - confirmed credit note exists and GL posted to 700-DEV instead of 720-OPS (JRN-2026-533).

03-10: Pulled ap-posting-svc logs: job 2026-03-03T02:12 processed CN-2026-03-02; mapping table lookup returned cost_center=700 due to stale mapping row (mapping_id=mc_map_02) that was not refreshed after PO migration on 2026-02-28.
03-11: Confirmed mapping table in AcmeLedger was updated in staging but not promoted to production. The promotion job failed with timeout and left the old mapping in place.
03-11: Cross-checked with Procurement: PO PO-4412 was migrated and assigned 720-OPS on 2026-02-27. Procurement confirmed no change to supplier Aurelio settings.
Hypothesis: deployment rollback timeout prevented mapping promotion which led ap-posting-svc to use legacy mapping during batch post.
comments: 2026-03-10 | Liam Chen (Assignee): Assigned to myself. Reproduced posting in ERP and extracted JRN-2026-533. Raising with infra to inspect deployment logs for mapping promotion.
2026-03-10 | Priya Rao (Infra): ap-deploy job #998 timed out on 2026-02-28 due to DB migration lock. We retried but promotion step was not applied to the production mapping table.
2026-03-11 | Elena Ortiz (Procurement): Confirmed PO cost center should be 720-OPS; vendor sent credit note referencing INV-2026-117. Procurement requests corrective journal and vendor notification.
2026-03-12 | Liam Chen: Created corrective journal CJ-2026-041 to reallocate $24,312 from 700-DEV -> 720-OPS pending approval. Finance approval requested from Head of Finance (Markus Engel).
resolution: Workaround/fix in progress: Created corrective journal CJ-2026-041 to move the credit amount to 720-OPS. Requested expedited approval from Head of Finance. Infra applied the missing mapping promotion and scheduled a verification run against recent AP batch posts to ensure no other mis-postings. Follow-ups: (1) run full reconciliation of March AP posts for mappings; (2) add a pre-deploy validation check to prevent mapping promotions from being skipped; (3) notify affected product finance leads after journals are posted.
next_steps: Obtain Head of Finance approval for CJ-2026-041 (Liam to chase).
Run reconciliation for March AP batch to identify other mis-postings (Finance Ops).
Implement pre-deploy validation in infra pipeline and add an alert when mapping promotion step fails (Infra/Platform).
Notify Procurement and affected cost center owners once CJ posts are complete and reconciliation cleared.
